newsitem.title: USA: Grubb & Ellis sees strong Manhattan market.
newsitem.headline: Grubb & Ellis sees strong Manhattan market.

text.p: The commercial real estate industry in Manhattan will be strong this year, according to the annual real estate forecast published by Grubb & Ellis Co.
Major redevelopment projects such as Times Square, Grand Central Station and Columbus Circle will draw new office and retail tenants to the city, the company said in the report.
The annual report reviews the trends of the past year and makes projections for the new one.
The report said that corporate flight from the city into the suburbs and other states may be slowing and that there have been some relocations back to Manhattan.
As a result, the total availability rate will fall into the single digits by the end of the year, and asking rental rates will edge up modestly, the company said.
The forecast also predicts that leasing activity in the city will rise.
